entry.title: Related work-order notice may differ from the searched notice after merging
entry.description: A fault notice detail view can show linked work-order rows whose notice column contains the merged primary notice number. Validate the searched notice in the filtered detail record, then preserve each related row's notice value instead of requiring equality.
applicable_when: Reading related work orders from a fault notice with merged-notice status
advantages: Prevents valid merged-notice rows from being rejected
Preserves the MMIS table's actual notice value
disadvantages: The query notice and row notice may differ, so consumers must interpret both fields
recommended_when: Building HTTP readers for MMIS related-record tables
notes: Confirmed by live HTTP read of fault notice 1150917-41 on 2026-10-02; its two related work orders display notice 1150915-58 and status 併單.
Keep the work-order business key mandatory and deduplicate by that key.
